```{r}

library(tidyverse)

library(p8105.datasets)
data("ny_noaa")

ny_noaa_df = ny_noaa |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  separate(date, into = c("year", "month", "day"), convert = TRUE)
  mutate(
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    prcp = prcp / 10,
    month = month.name(month)
  )
  
#convert = TRUE from AI helper
#usually divided by 10 apparently, and months gives you game months

ny_noaa_df


```
